name: Battery Depth of Discharge in Eclipse
description: Depth of discharge of the satellite battery during the eclipse phase. Checks whether battery lifetime requirements are met.

elements.name: Maximum Depth of Discharge
elements.description: Worst-case DoD during the longest eclipse. Uncertain due to load variation and battery ageing.

uncertainty.source: Power budget analysis with load and temperature uncertainty

elements.name: Maximum DoD for Design Lifetime
elements.description: Li-ion battery maximum DoD for 15-year cycle life

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ₁₂(DoD) = DoD, σ₂₁(DoD) = DoD; F = [1], f = [0] in both directions
consistency_relations.upr_description: The depth of discharge is the same physical quantity in both the power budget model (which computes DoD from eclipse loads) and the battery lifetime model (which constrains DoD to preserve cycle life). The bidirectional identity mapping synchronises the uncertainty sets from both models, and consistency requires their intersection — the jointly admissible DoD range — to be non-empty.
